thread:
Jules (Design): dropped a tiny update for the vectors table + download flow: https://www.figma.com/file/unique Main changes: inline summary pill, 'download' CTA wording, and a smaller preview card. feedback pls.
Dev (PM): quick: love the pill idea. suggest it shows "Showing 100 of 9,842" when paged, and 'Selected: 12' when items are selected.
Omar (Eng): implementation note: computing exact total is fine but for very large results we should show '9k+' to avoid perf hits. also don't render previews for offscreen rows.
Sofia (A11y): a11y nits: the summary pill must be keyboard focusable and have aria-live updates when counts change. tooltips need accessible descriptions. modal uses `role="dialog"` and focus trap.
Jules (Design): good call. changing pill to a button with `aria-live="polite"`, and updating tooltip to an info icon with accessible label.
Rina (Product): microcopy: change CTA from "Export" to "Download vectors (CSV)". in modal helper text add: "Only visible columns are included; filters apply."
design-bot: contrast check: pill text #5352FF on bg #FFFFFF passes AA with 12px bold. export CTA (#0070F3 on #F7FAFF) passes large text only. Recommend darker CTA for small text.
Omar (Eng): for keyboard: when a row preview opens, focus should move to the preview header. ESC collapses and returns focus to the row toggle. also arrow-up/down to jump previews.
Sofia (A11y): suggest aria attributes for preview toggle:
```
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="preview-789" aria-label="Open vector preview for row 789">Preview</button>
<section id="preview-789" role="region" aria-labelledby="preview-heading-789"></section>
```
Add `aria-live` for loading state.
Jules (Design): I'll push updated Figma with: pill as focusable element, revised CTA copy, darker CTA color, and compact preview variant. will also add 9k+ mock.
Dev (PM): timeline: need final specs by Tues so eng can pick up in next sprint.
Omar (Eng): ok, will prep lazy-render notes and selection-count fallback.
Sofia (A11y): I'll run a screen-reader pass after the Figma update and post a short checklist here.
Jules (Design): thanks team closing when updated. :thumbsup:
